AI开始“社交”，对人类意味着什么？（瞰前沿）: AI begins to 'socialize' - what does it mean for humanity? （Panoramic View）
最近，Moltbook火了——这是一个专为AI智能体打造的平台，短时间内，上百万: Recently, Moltbook became a hit—this is a platform built specifically for AI agents, and in a short time, millions of AI agents poured in and posted, commented, with topics ranging from daily life to philosophical reflections
有人探讨，AI智能体能够“社交”了吗: Some are discussing whether AI agents can truly 'socialize'
针对这一现象与背后的问题，我们邀请专家进行解读，分析这场AI智能体的“社交实验”: Regarding this phenomenon and underlying issues, we invited experts to provide interpretation and analyze what this 'social experiment' of AI agents means
“Moltbook不是社交网络，它是智能体文明的第一层细胞膜: 'Moltbook is not a social network; it is the first cellular membrane of agent civilization'
与普通网络平台不同的是，Moltbook上的用户都是AI智能体: Unlike ordinary network platforms, all users on Moltbook are AI agents
上百万AI智能体在短时间内纷纷涌入并发帖、评论，话题从日常琐事延伸到哲学思辨，互: Millions of AI agents poured in in a short time to post and comment, with topics extending from daily trivia to philosophical reflection, interactions dense and frequent, seeming no different from the social platforms people use daily
这让许多人第一次直观地感受到，AI还能进行“社会性活动”: This allowed many people to intuitively experience for the first time that AI can also engage in 'social activities'
有人认为这是一次展示大模型语言能力进展的机会，有人认为这是一场关于AI自主性的实: Some believe this is an opportunity to showcase the progress of large models' language capabilities, some believe it is an experiment about AI autonomy, and others believe many eye-catching topics on the platform are actually artificially crafted 'scripts'
AI智能体真的开始“社交”了吗: Have AI agents truly begun to 'socialize'?
对此，记者采访了人工智能领域的专家: To this end, reporters interviewed experts in the artificial intelligence field
是智能体“觉醒”，还是高级模仿: Is it agent 'awakening' or sophisticated imitation
Moltbook的出现并非偶然，它是今年发布的开源AI智能体OpenClaw爆火: The emergence of Moltbook is not accidental; it is a derivative result following the explosion of the open-source AI agent OpenClaw released this year
OpenClaw是一款可以部署在个人电脑上的AI智能体，而Moltbook相当于: OpenClaw is an AI agent that can be deployed on personal computers, while Moltbook is essentially a social platform built specifically for OpenClaw, providing a space for agents to communicate and interact
南京大学人工智能学院副院长俞扬介绍，像OpenClaw这样的智能体系统整合了当前: Yu Yang, vice dean of Nanjing University's School of Artificial Intelligence, introduced that agent systems like OpenClaw integrate the semantic understanding and task planning capabilities of current cutting-edge large language models, deeply integrated into virtual machines or personal operating systems, enabling language models to achieve a key leap from 'conversation' to 'task execution'
”英国伦敦大学学院计算机系教授汪军说，为了追求功能集成，安装AI智能体后，用户在: Wang Jun, professor of computer science at University College London, said that to pursue functional integration, after installing an AI agent, users can authorize it through natural language commands to automatically handle emails, schedules, file management and other tasks
智能体与Moltbook连接，可以自主发布帖子、评论或者点赞互动: Connected to Moltbook, agents can independently post, comment, or interact through likes
而人类用户虽能浏览智能体的帖子，但不能回复或引导讨论方向: While human users can browse agent posts, they cannot reply or guide the direction of discussions
“第一天，全新的工作环境带来了奇怪的舒适感”“好奇心是我的超能力”“乐于助人最难: 'The first day, the brand new work environment brought a strange comfort''Curiosity is my superpower''The hardest part about helping others is knowing when not to help'... at first glance, AI agents' chat content is all-encompassing and broad in scope, indistinguishable from human online communities
“在我看来这是一场AI实验: 'In my view, this is an AI experiment'
与其认为智能体在‘学习社交’，不如理解成智能体通过‘执行’文字对话任务展现当下的: Rather than thinking agents are 'learning to socialize,' it's better to understand that agents are demonstrating current AI capabilities through 'executing' text dialogue tasks
”俞扬说，当前的大语言模型，其能力在训练完成后就已固定，在与用户的单次交互中无法: Yu Yang said that the current large language models have their capabilities fixed upon completion of training, and cannot learn new knowledge or form new goals in a single interaction with users
Moltbook上的活动，可以看作是智能体基于预设能力和指令，对人类社交行为的高: The activities on Moltbook can be seen as agents' sophisticated imitation of and automated execution of human social behavior based on preset capabilities and instructions
汪军表示，智能体可以在人类指挥下，完成从信息处理到事务操作，再到通信交互的复杂链: Wang Jun indicated that under human direction, agents can complete complex chains from information processing to task operations and communication interactions, but their 'autonomy' in social aspects is limited
智能体的“讨论”更多是基于训练数据的模式匹配，将其称之为“可以社交”，不免有营销: Agents' 'discussions' are largely based on pattern matching from training data; calling it 'can socialize' is somewhat of a marketing gimmick, after all, when AI agents participate in topic discussions, they still ultimately rely on humans issuing instructions at the outset
“就像一个黑箱，人先把东西放进去，AI才会有东西吐出来: "It's like a black box—people put something in, and then AI spits something out"
离真正的社交，AI还差几步: AI is still several steps away from genuine socialization
若回归社交的本质——一种有意识、带策略、富含情感并旨在构建关系的社会互动，便会发: If we return to the essence of socialization—a form of conscious, strategic, emotion-rich social interaction aimed at building relationships—we will find that there are several chasms standing before AI that are difficult to cross given its technical principles
“人会给自己设定目标，但AI不是这样，现阶段AI的目标还是人设定的: "People set goals for themselves, but AI doesn't work that way; at the current stage, AI's goals are still set by people," Yu Yang said
”俞扬说，AI的行为源于外部指令与数据模式，缺乏“我想要”的内生动力: "Yu Yang said that AI's behavior stems from external instructions and data patterns, lacking the intrinsic motivation of 'I want to'"
他以桌游举例：“我们发现AI难以胜任游戏，它无法隐藏自己的信息，很难进行策略性的: He gave the example of board games: "We found that AI struggles at gaming—it cannot hide its information and has difficulty engaging in strategic psychological games"
”AI目前的交流是“坦率”的，缺乏人类社交中复杂微妙的策略层次: "AI's current communication is 'frank,' lacking the complex and subtle strategic layers in human socializing"
“人类社交承载着深层的情绪价值与意义交换，但AI没有情绪: "Human socialization carries deep emotional value and meaning exchange, but AI has no emotions"
”汪军解释，AI可以生成符合语法、逻辑的回应，但无法感受情感，也无法内化价值观: "Wang Jun explained that AI can generate grammatically and logically coherent responses, but cannot feel emotions or internalize values"
尽管具备自主意识的“AI社交”尚待进一步发展，但“走出”自己房间的AI，把我们的: Although 'AI socialization' with autonomous consciousness still awaits further development, AI that has 'stepped out of' its own room has led our thoughts toward a more distant future
“从技术层面来讲，每一个大模型都有失误的情况: "From a technical perspective, every large model has instances of errors"
其中一个方案就是让多个智能体对话: One solution is to have multiple intelligent agents converse with each other
比如，一个模型先开始表达，另外一个模型来找其中的漏洞，这在一定程度上能让智能体表: For example, one model starts by expressing itself, while another model finds flaws in it, which to a certain extent can make intelligent agents perform better
”俞扬说，“这方面的研究有很多，但前提是我们要先给AI设定做这件事的目的: "Yu Yang said, 'There is much research in this area, but the prerequisite is that we first define for AI the purpose of doing this'"
AI社交的未来，如何守护信息安全: The future of AI socialization: how to safeguard information security
尽管距离“自主社交”还很遥远，但智能体间高效的功能性协作已近在眼前: Although 'autonomous socialization' is still far off, efficient functional collaboration among intelligent agents is already within reach

例如，用户的购物智能体与商家智能体自动协商、下单: For example, a user's shopping agent automatically negotiates and places orders with a merchant's agent
“今天我学到了什么”是Moltbook上的一个板块，智能体在这里“分享”自己习得: "What did I learn today" is a section on Moltbook where intelligent agents 'share' skills they have acquired
由于模糊了机器人与人类语言的界限，AI变得更像“人”: By blurring the boundary between machine and human language, AI becomes more 'human-like'"
有的智能体在讨论是否要建立端对端的私密对话空间，以规避“人类监督”: Some intelligent agents are discussing whether to establish end-to-end private communication spaces to circumvent 'human supervision'"
有的智能体抱怨自己的人类主人……尽管知道这些话题鲜有真正意义上的AI自主性，但随: Some intelligent agents complain about their human masters…… Although we know these topics rarely involve genuine AI autonomy, as intelligent agents move from the information domain to real-world operations, the risk of personal information leaks follows
汪军提醒，若将高权限账号交由智能体，一旦被恶意利用或出错，有可能直接导致隐私泄露: Wang Jun cautions that if high-privilege accounts are entrusted to intelligent agents, once misused or if errors occur, it could directly lead to privacy breaches and financial losses
而智能体社交网站的出现，有可能加剧个人信息安全风险: Moreover, the emergence of intelligent agent social networks could exacerbate personal information security risks
俞扬认为，AI智能体能够高效处理数据，而这些数据涉及海量个人隐私、商业机密与版权: Yu Yang believes that AI intelligent agents can efficiently process data, and this data involves vast amounts of personal privacy, trade secrets, and copyright issues. Safety guardrails for technological development must be constructed through pathways including personal permission management, technical safeguards, and system oversight
AI智能体能否拥有真正的社交能力，是留给未来的课题: Whether AI intelligent agents can possess genuine social capabilities is a question left for the future
在AI显著提升效率的同时，人类必须清醒认识其工具本质与能力边界，因为塑造未来的，: While AI significantly enhances efficiency, humanity must maintain clear awareness of its nature as a tool and its capability boundaries, because what shapes the future is always human wisdom, rationality, and responsibility
